info.title: CommonGroundChecker API
info.description: Machine-readable API description for repository metadata, analysis results, and scoring configuration.

get.summary: List known repositories with latest summary

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of repositories to return

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search term matched against owner, name, description and repository URL, and exactly (lowercased) against topics. Omit or leave blank to list all repositories.

post.summary: Run full analysis and persist result
Create a new analysis result for an existing repository

put.summary: Follow or unfollow a repository for scheduled rescans
put.description: Admin only. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>`. Disabled with 503 when the backend has no ADMIN_TOKEN configured.

503.description: Admin actions are disabled because ADMIN_TOKEN is not configured

get.summary: Declared and confirmed users and the SLAs of a repository
get.description: Declared users come from the latest analysis. Confirmed users are the declared organisations with a confirmation recorded by an admin.

post.summary: Record that an organisation confirmed it uses the component
post.description: Admin only. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>`. Disabled with 503 when the backend has no ADMIN_TOKEN configured.

409.description: The organisation is already confirmed for this repository

503.description: Admin actions are disabled because ADMIN_TOKEN is not configured

get.summary: Return analysis history for a repository

checkIntervalHours.description: 24 (daily), 168 (weekly) or 720 (monthly). Defaults to the stored interval, or 168 when following for the first time

followed.description: Whether the repository is rescanned on a schedule

lastCheckedAt.description: When the latest analysis was stored

nextCheckAt.description: When the repository is next due for a scheduled check

shortDescription.description: Short description from publiccode.yml: the Dutch one if present, else English, else the first available language

logoUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the logo from publiccode.yml (logo), resolved to the git host's raw URL when it is a repository path

maintainers.description: Maintainers from publiccode.yml: the names in maintenance.contacts, else the organisation names (maintenance.contractors, organisation)

shortDescription.description: Short description from publiccode.yml: the Dutch one if present, else English, else the first available language

maintainers.description: Maintainers from publiccode.yml: the names in maintenance.contacts, else the organisation names (maintenance.contractors, organisation)

Rating.description: Continuous rating from 0.5 to 5.5, shown as 1 to 5 stars; null when no criterion counts

CategoryRatings.description: Rating per category; a category is null when none of its aspects is rated

found.description: For a document-count aspect: the inputs that pass

expected.description: For a document-count aspect: the inputs that were measured

passed.description: No mandatory criterion fails and the overall rating is at least 2.5

errors.description: Entries in the report's errors block: failing mandatory criteria, plus an overall rating below 2.5

warnings.description: Entries in the report's warnings block: missing or incomplete items

declaredUsers.description: The organisations under usedBy in publiccode.yml. Leave out when the scan did not read them

declaredUserCount.description: Organisations under usedBy at this analysis, or null when it did not record them

confirmedUserCount.description: Declared organisations with a confirmation at the time of this analysis

followed.description: Whether the repository is rescanned on a schedule

lastCheckedAt.description: When the latest analysis was stored

nextCheckAt.description: When the repository is next due for a scheduled check

shortDescription.description: Short description from publiccode.yml: the Dutch one if present, else English, else the first available language

logoUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the logo from publiccode.yml (logo), resolved to the git host's raw URL when it is a repository path

maintainers.description: Maintainers from publiccode.yml: the names in maintenance.contacts, else the organisation names (maintenance.contractors, organisation)

starRating.description: 1 to 5 stars; from the criterion's own scale, or derived from its status

rating.description: Continuous rating from 0.5 to 5.5, for a criterion measured on a continuous scale

aspectRatings.description: Ratings from 0.5 to 5.5 the check measures for aspects of the rating model, by key

organisation.description: The organisation as named under usedBy in publiccode.yml; matched case-insensitively and trimmed

source.description: Link to the written confirmation or the register entry

party.description: Who agreed the SLA, for example VNG

declared.description: Whether the latest analysis declares this organisation under usedBy; only declared organisations count as confirmed users

declaredUsers.description: Organisations under usedBy in the latest analysis, or null when it did not record them
